paper.title: Reinforced UI Instruction Grounding: Towards a Generic UI Task Automation API
paper.central_claim: RUIG, a metadata-free screenshot+instruction grounding model (Swin encoder, BART decoder, pixel-to-sequence box tokens, document-understanding initialisation) trained with an additional policy-gradient objective rewarding the IoU of decoded coordinate tokens, outperforms state-of-the-art methods including metadata-based ones by a clear margin and shows potential as a generic UI task automation API.
paper.scope_as_measured: Single-step click-in-box accuracy and mIoU on MoTIF/RicoSCA mobile seen/unseen-app splits and an author-generated 37K-image Common Crawl web set (seen/unseen).

status_reason: Material ruling: the published v1 (body + Appendix A–E) is complete; Appendix A is the "supplementary" referred to in §4.1 (O02, O03). The promised split statistics and web-collection details were never included in the published version — they are not reported, not missing material, and are not required to score the central controlled claim (mobile results use a public benchmark configuration, O05).
opus_initial_reading: Read before any seat file: component_training grounding model; CE + REINFORCE with IoU reward on coordinate tokens (64 MC samples). Evidence offline single-step: MoTIF public configuration (O05) and an author-built web set (O14). Controlled same-architecture baseline with/without pretraining (O15); granularity, token-subset (Table 4) and decoder-depth ablations; reproduced Spotlight*. Cost +38% per epoch (O13). Body promises data statistics and web-collection details in "our supplementary" (O01, O02); Appendix A opens by continuing §4.1 implementation details (O03) and Appendix E ends "We will clarify this in our revision" (O04) — i.e. the appendices are the supplementary as published, and the promised statistics were never included. Prose table numbers disagree with captions twice (O06 vs O07; O08 vs O09/O10). Closest cited prior, task-reward tuning of CV models (O12), is mentioned only generically (O11).

resolutions.reason: §4.1 sends both implementation details (O02) and data statistics (O01) to "our supplementary"; Appendix A explicitly continues §4.1 implementation details (O03) and Appendix E carries a revision promise (O04), so the appendices are the supplementary as published. The statistics are absent from the paper itself, not from our copy: SCORE_SPEC "not_reported" applies once full material is searched. Scoring necessity: the central claim is a controlled same-architecture comparison whose mobile splits follow a public configuration (O05); the missing web statistics weaken E.holdout/E.statistics and are scorable as such. Table-number mismatches (O06/O07, O08/O09/O10) are recorded as source counterevidence; numbers within each table are internally coherent.
